title: Cloudflare Blog
description: Technical deep dives, product updates, and insights from the teams that are helping to build a better Internet.

items.title: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers
items.content: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine.
items.contentSnippet: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine.
items.creator: Willi Geiger

items.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
items.content: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings.

items.creator: Michelle Chen

items.title: 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability
items.content: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.
items.contentSnippet: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.
items.creator: Nevi Shah

items.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
items.content: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.
items.contentSnippet: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.
items.creator: Mar Witek

items.title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
items.content: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. Here is an update on our progress, how we dogfood these tools internally, and what is coming next.

items.title: Announcing Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway – expanding access to Cloudflare’s privacy-preserving infrastructure
items.content: We’re announcing the closed beta of a self-serve Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway. We’re also renaming our Privacy Gateway to Cloudflare OHTTP Relay to better distinguish the two products.

items.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse
items.content: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks. Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.

items.creator: Nicole Justus

items.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project
items.content: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication. Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app. No Cloudflare account required on either side.
